jobs.description:
The Team Our Authorisation and Core Services team builds and evolves the foundational capabilities that power multiple products and business domains across the bank. We develop scalable, secure, and reliable platform services that enable other engineering teams to deliver solutions faster and more consistently. By leveraging modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices, we create reusable capabilities that reduce complexity, accelerate innovation, and provide a strong foundation for future growth. The Role We’re looking for a Senior Engineer to join one of our core engineering teams. In this role, you will help design, build, and evolve foundational services and platform capabilities that are used across multiple product teams. You will work on highly scalable and reliable solutions that enable other teams to deliver business value efficiently while contributing to the overall architecture and technical direction of the platform. What You’ll Do
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Java, Quarkus, and PostgreSQL, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and maintainability.
• Build and operate event-driven solutions leveraging Kafka and asynchronous messaging patterns to enable seamless integration and communication across multiple platforms and teams.
• Design, implement, and maintain cloud-native solutions on AWS, applying infrastructure and operational best practices to ensure scalability, security, and resilience.
• Develop and drive authentication and authorization capabilities, including identity integration, access control, and security standards, ensuring secure and compliant platform services.
• Ensure high-quality, secure code with comprehensive test coverage
• Collaborate with SRE, Security, and Platform teams to ensure resilience, observability, and compliance
• Take ownership of the full development lifecycle — from design to production
• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement
• Proven experience developing and operating backend applications using Java and modern frameworks such as Quarkus or Spring Boot.
• Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture and hands-on experience with AWS services, including deployment, monitoring, security, and operational best practices.
• Experience designing and implementing event-driven architectures and distributed systems using messaging technologies such as Kafka.
• Solid understanding of relational database design, data modeling, and performance optimization, particularly with PostgreSQL.
• Practical experience implementing authentication and authorization solutions, including OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, and secure service-to-service communication.
• Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including clean code, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure as code.
• Experience building and operating highly available, scalable, and resilient systems in production environments.
• A proactive mindset with a passion for solving complex technical challenges, driving continuous improvement, and collaborating across teams.
• Agile, product-oriented approach with a strong ownership mentality and curiosity for new technologies and engineering practices. What Will Make You Stand Out
• Ability to handle both infrastructure and application development
• Ownership mindset: you resolve issues and bring the right people together
• Passion for innovation and continuous learning Our Engineering Culture Do you identify with these values and principles?
• Team first mindset. The team above its individuals
• Our people always first. Everything starts there
• We deliver frequently, with high quality and security. Yup, that’s right.
• We celebrate success and learn from failures. The key to a healthy balance.
• We are pragmatic and look for simplicity. KISS everywhere
• We have positive impact. We deliver results. Joining Sygnum means being part of a dynamic, global team that is building a trusted gateway between the traditional and digital asset economies. Working at Sygnum, you will experience our fast-paced, exciting work environment that embraces meritocracy and collaboration and open communication. Alongside our ambitious long-term mission, we also come together for reaching important milestones and annual crypto-industry anniversaries like Bitcoin Pizza Day, and regularly celebrate together at themed company events as part of our journey to shape Future Finance. Sygnum offers a comprehensive package of benefits for all team members. They include:
• Attractive combination of market salaries and entrepreneurial incentive scheme
• Flexible/Work at home policies
• Professional development via Mentoring and Buddy programs
• One-month fully paid sabbatical after five years of continuous employment If you are passionate about the potential of blockchain to shape Future Finance and your profile is a good fit for this position, please send us your CV today!

• Progettare, implementare e mantenere soluzioni cloud-native su AWS, applicando infrastrutture e best practice operative per garantire scalabilità, sicurezza e resilienza.
• Sviluppare e guidare le funzionalità di autenticazione e autorizzazione, tra cui l'integrazione dell'identità, il controllo degli accessi e gli standard di sicurezza, garantendo servizi di piattaforma sicuri e conformi.

• Collabora con i team SRE, Security e Platform per garantire resilienza, osservanza e conformità
• Prendere la proprietà del ciclo di vita di sviluppo completo — dalla progettazione alla produzione
• Mentor junior ingegneri e contribuire a una cultura di miglioramento continuo
• Provata esperienza di sviluppo e funzionamento applicazioni backend utilizzando Java e quadri moderni come Quarkus o Spring Boot.
• Forte conoscenza dell'architettura cloud-native e dell'esperienza pratica con i servizi AWS, tra cui distribuzione, monitoraggio, sicurezza e best practice operative.
• La progettazione e l'implementazione di architetture orientate agli eventi e sistemi distribuiti utilizzando tecnologie di messaggistica come Kafka.
• Solida comprensione della progettazione del database relazionale, della modellazione dei dati e dell'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, in particolare con PostgreSQL.
• Esperienza pratica che implementa soluzioni di autenticazione e autorizzazione, tra cui OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT e comunicazione di servizio-servizio sicura.
• Forte comprensione delle best practice di ingegneria del software, compreso il codice pulito, test automatizzati, tubazioni CI/CD, osservabilità e infrastruttura come codice.
• Esperienza di costruzione e funzionamento sistemi altamente disponibili, scalabili e resilienti in ambienti di produzione.
• Una mentalità proattiva con la passione per la soluzione di complesse sfide tecniche, il miglioramento continuo e la collaborazione tra team.
• Agile, approccio orientato al prodotto con una forte mentalità di proprietà e curiosità per le nuove tecnologie e pratiche ingegneristiche. Che cosa ti farà stare in piedi
• Capacità di gestire sia l'infrastruttura che lo sviluppo delle applicazioni
• Proprietario mentalità: risolvere i problemi e riunire le persone giuste
• Passione per l'innovazione e l'apprendimento continuo Si identifica con questi valori e principi?
• Squadra prima mentalità. Il team sopra i suoi individui
• La nostra gente e' sempre la prima. Tutto inizia lì
• Offriamo frequentemente, con alta qualità e sicurezza. Sì, è vero.
• Festeggiamo il successo e impariamo dai fallimenti. La chiave di un equilibrio sano.
• Siamo pragmatici e cerchiamo semplicità. KISS ovunque
• Abbiamo un impatto positivo. Consegniamo risultati. Unirsi a Sygnum significa essere parte di un team dinamico e globale che sta costruendo un gateway affidabile tra le economie di asset tradizionali e digitali. Lavorando a Sygnum, sperimenterete il nostro ambiente di lavoro veloce ed emozionante che abbraccia la meritocrazia e la collaborazione e la comunicazione aperta. Accanto alla nostra ambiziosa missione a lungo termine, ci uniamo anche per raggiungere importanti pietre miliari e anniversari cripto-industriali annuali come Bitcoin Pizza Day, e regolarmente celebrare insieme a eventi aziendali a tema come parte del nostro viaggio per formare Future Finance. Sygnum offre un pacchetto completo di vantaggi per tutti i membri del team. Essi includono:

• Flessibile / Lavoro nelle politiche domestiche
• Sviluppo professionale tramite programmi Mentoring e Buddy

• Zusammenarbeit mit SRE-, Sicherheits- und Plattformteams, um Resilienz, Beobachtbarkeit und Compliance sicherzustellen
• Übernehmen Sie den gesamten Entwicklungslebenszyklus - vom Design bis zur Produktion

• Bewährte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb von Backend-Anwendungen mit Java und modernen Frameworks wie Quarkus oder Spring Boot.
• Kenntnis der Cloud-nativen Architektur und praktische Erfahrung mit AWS-Services, einschließlich Bereitstellung, Überwachung, Sicherheit und Best Practices für den Betrieb.

jobs.description:
This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of a digital-native and FINMA-regulated bank with an international footprint, combining the pace and technology stack of a digital-first organization with the rigor of a regulated financial institution. We are looking for an experienced Information Security Risk Manager to join our Information Security function in Zurich. Reporting to the CISO, you will own the security control catalogue end to end, drive the enterprise information security risk assessment process, and act as the primary liaison for regulatory and audit engagements. You will also help modernize how we monitor and report on control performance by automating oversight across cloud, endpoint, and other data sources, and you will keep the organization security-aware through an engaging awareness program. Key responsibilities: · Own the information security control catalogue, including control oversight, effectiveness rating, KPI measurement, and deficiency remediation. · Manage and perform the top-down and bottom-up information security risk assessment processes · Provide subject matter expert input relating to all aspects including IT risks, security measures, controls, and remedial actions. · Drive automation of security oversight processes, integrating information from multiple sources (cloud, endpoint, and others) into unified reporting dashboards. · Provide information risk and security subject matter expertise inputs and assessments to our IT and business teams in support of their risk management activities. · Oversee information security audits, whether performed by the Bank or third- parties. · Support our culture development of information and security risk awareness, hence, good conduct through supporting regular communications, awareness, and training.
• 5+ years of professional experience in information risk frameworks and management and IT audit, preferably in a mid/large-sized financial institution or audit company.
• Solid working knowledge of recognized frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or CSA CCM, and experience applying them to real-world control environments.
• Professional certification such as CISSP, CISM, or CRISC (or actively working toward one).
• Familiarity with security tooling and data sources across cloud and endpoint environments, and an interest in automating oversight and reporting (e.g., dashboards, GRC platforms, scripting/BI tools).
• Proven communication and interpersonal skills, including multi-stakeholder management.
• Strong communication skills, written and verbal in English.
